legal_snapshot.publication_rule: Rospatent application field 5 asks for country and year of first publication/release only if publication under Civil Code Article 1268 occurred before filing. Public disclosure and publication are not treated as identical by default. For this Wave 1 filing, the applicant has expressly instructed that the field be completed as Russia, 2026.
legal_snapshot.author_rule: Rospatent filing materials distinguish the author's legal identity from the author's publication choice. A named author may request publication under a pseudonym; the public record may use that pseudonym while the legal author identity remains in the private filing materials.
